svg.title: Episteme — C4 container view
svg.desc: C4 container diagram: a learner uses the Astro web app, which calls the FastAPI API and RAG engine running Qwen2.5 on CUDA; the engine retrieves from a FAISS index and kNN graph and reads and writes a lakehouse of SeaweedFS object storage (Bronze) and Apache Iceberg tables (Silver); a Python CLI ingests course material with OCR and rebuilds the index; model weights come from the Hugging Face Hub and a Cloudflare tunnel exposes demos.
